title: Briefing on gas safety rules and Amazon's new power plant
description: Recent reports cover domestic gas safety reminders and Amazon's confirmation of a gas power plant in Texas driven by AI needs.

sections.heading: Domestic Gas Safety
paragraphs: According to République Togolaise, there has been a reminder issued regarding the safety rules for domestic gas.

sections.heading: Amazon's Data Center Energy
paragraphs: BFM reports that Amazon has confirmed the construction of a gas power plant in Texas for its data centers.
The report by BFM mentions a comparison suggesting the building's emissions could represent almost 10% of France's annual CO2 emissions.

sections.heading: AI and Power Generation
paragraphs: Menow reports that Artificial Intelligence is pushing tech giants to construct their own power plants.

faq.q: What did Amazon confirm regarding gas?
faq.a: According to BFM, Amazon confirmed the construction of a gas power plant in Texas for its data centers.

faq.q: Why are tech giants building power plants?
faq.a: Menow reports that AI is driving tech giants to build their own power plants.

faq.q: What was the topic of the report by République Togolaise?
